## Neon authentication cutover (production)

- User requested the Neon cutover after an Access-denied login attempt. The denial was the **existing Cloudflare Access policy**, not the database migration: `ONBOARDING_ADMIN_EMAILS` and `ONBOARDING_ACCESS_AUD` match the existing app, while the old admin URL still passes through Access.
- Created a dedicated least-privilege Postgres role `launchloom_worker_prod` (`LOGIN`, no superuser/createdb/createrole/inherit/bypassrls/replication), with only database connect, schema usage and function execute. Verified it returns membership data through the security-definer functions and is denied direct table access. Its connection URL is stored only in a mode-600 local file.
- Created and verified the production owner account for `david@maigreeks.com` in Neon Auth, added the owner membership and `access:<sha256(email)>` legacy link, and verified the owner row. The temporary password is stored only in a mode-600 local file.
- Configured repository variables `ADMIN_AUTH_MODE=neon`, `ADMIN_PUBLIC_ORIGIN=https://launchloom-api.dark-sound-e4eb.workers.dev`, `NEON_AUTH_BASE_URL`, and secrets `ADMIN_DATABASE_URL` / `NEON_AUTH_COOKIE_SECRET`. Deploy run `39624753041` completed **success**.
- Production verification: `https://launchloom-api.dark-sound-e4eb.workers.dev/admin/login` returns 200; `/admin/onboarding-invites` redirects to login when signed out; a real Chromium sign-in as `david@maigreeks.com` reached the Generations workspace; `/workspace/me` returns owner/active/neon and `/workspace/team` returns both owners. The old `api.launchloom.wrazyos.com/admin/onboarding-invites` remains behind the existing Access application, so it is not the Neon entry point yet.

## Admin cutover polish shipped and verified

- UTC completed: 2026-10-21T17:35Z.
- PR #177 (`Admin cutover polish: branded entry and password controls`) merged as `10f68f7f`; CI `validate` and `route-fixtures` passed; deploy run `39642032815` succeeded.

Authorized backfill write run `39644063940` completed: 8 reads, 0 upserts, 372 warnings, no errors.
